protocol_type: Byte-oriented, telegram-based master-slave fieldbus protocol with a hybrid token-passing medium-access control. The token holder (a master) sends a request telegram to a slave (selected by Destination Address and Service Access Point); the slave responds with a data telegram or a short acknowledgement within the slot time. Each telegram is framed by a Start Delimiter (SD1/SD2/SD3/SD4), carries DA/SA/FC and optional DSAP/SSAP, and (for data/fixed telegrams) ends with an 8-bit FCS and ED=0x16.

medium_access_control.token_passing: Active stations (masters) form a logical token ring in ascending station-address order; only the token holder may initiate message cycles, bounded by the Target Rotation Time (TTR). The Token telegram (SD4) passes the token; GAP/Live-List maintenance admits or removes stations.
medium_access_control.master_slave: While holding the token a master polls its assigned slaves (request -> response within the slot time TSL); passive slaves never initiate transmission.
medium_access_control.classes: DP Class-1 master (DPM1) runs the cyclic data exchange; DP Class-2 master (DPM2) is an engineering/diagnostic/configuration device.

telegram_types.name: SD1 fixed-length, no data
telegram_types.format: SD1 | DA | SA | FC | FCS | ED
telegram_types.purpose: Poll, FDL status request, diagnostic request.

telegram_types.name: SD2 variable-length with data
telegram_types.format: SD2 | LE | LEr | SD2 | DA | SA | FC | (DSAP | SSAP) | DU... | FCS | ED
telegram_types.purpose: Normal data telegram (cyclic I/O, acyclic services); LE is the length, repeated as LEr.

telegram_types.name: SD3 fixed-length with 8 data octets
telegram_types.format: SD3 | DA | SA | FC | DU(8) | FCS | ED

telegram_types.name: SC short acknowledgement
telegram_types.purpose: Positive short ACK with no data.

telegram_fields.name: DA
telegram_fields.purpose: Station address 0..127 of the receiver; bit 7 (EXT) indicates a DSAP byte follows.

telegram_fields.name: SA
telegram_fields.purpose: Station address of the sender; EXT bit indicates an SSAP byte follows.

telegram_fields.name: FC
telegram_fields.purpose: Frame type (SRD/SDN/Request-FDL-Status/Token), Frame Count Bit (FCB) + FCB-Valid (FCV), and station type / FDL state.

telegram_fields.name: DSAP
telegram_fields.purpose: Selects the DP service at the receiver (present when DA.EXT=1).

telegram_fields.name: SSAP
telegram_fields.purpose: Selects the service at the sender (present when SA.EXT=1). Default SAP is used for cyclic Data_Exchange.

telegram_fields.name: FCS
telegram_fields.purpose: 8-bit arithmetic checksum (modulo-256 sum of DA+SA+FC+data); NOT a CRC.

dp_services.purpose: Broadcast SYNC (freeze outputs) / FREEZE (freeze inputs) to slave groups.
Read/write a data record by Slot and Index (MSAC_C1 / MSAC_C2).
Acknowledged process / diagnostic / pull-plug / status / update alarms.

fcs.note: PROFIBUS uses an 8-bit arithmetic FCS, not a polynomial CRC.

addressing.service_access_points: DSAP / SSAP select the L7 service when the address EXT bit is set; default SAP = cyclic Data_Exchange.
